rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (LAHD)
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
rules.plain_language: The JCO prohibits terminating tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions for most City of Los Angeles residential property that is not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
rules.explanation: The JCO prohibits terminating tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions for most City of Los Angeles residential property that is not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance.

rules.citation: LAHD — Evictions for Non-Payment of Rent (RSO & JCO)
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR)
rules.plain_language: For every RSO and JCO rental unit in Los Angeles, a landlord may not evict for nonpayment unless the tenant owes more than the Fair Market Rent for the unit's bedroom size.
rules.explanation: For every RSO and JCO rental unit in Los Angeles, a landlord may not evict for nonpayment unless the tenant owes more than the Fair Market Rent for the unit's bedroom size.

rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV (RSO) — LAHD RSO overview
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
rules.plain_language: Rental property first built on or before October 1, 1978 may receive a rent increase only once every 12 months and only at the LAHD allowable percentage; increases needing LAHD approval are listed separately by LAHD.
rules.explanation: Rental property first built on or before October 1, 1978 may receive a rent increase only once every 12 months and only at the LAHD allowable percentage; increases needing LAHD approval are listed separately by LAHD.

rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
rules.plain_language: For the LAHD-published window July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 the maximum annual allowable rent increase for RSO units is 3%; LAHD sets a new percentage each July, so confirm the current window before relying on the figure.
rules.explanation: For the LAHD-published window July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 the maximum annual allowable rent increase for RSO units is 3%; LAHD sets a new percentage each July, so confirm the current window before relying on the figure.

rules.quoted_span:
All tenant not- at-fault evictions require payment of relocation assistance and the filing of a 
Declaration of Intent to Evict form
rules.plain_language: Every no-fault (not-at-fault) eviction of an RSO or JCO tenant requires payment of relocation assistance and filing a Declaration of Intent to Evict with the LA Housing Department before the tenant may be served with a termination notice.
rules.explanation: Every no-fault (not-at-fault) eviction of an RSO or JCO tenant requires payment of relocation assistance and filing a Declaration of Intent to Evict with the LA Housing Department before the tenant may be served with a termination notice.

deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant
